text:
sara_sales: Kicking off FinTrace POC — customer requires EU-only processing for model runtime. They want BYO-KMS (customer-managed HSM) and minimal sub-processors outside EU. Asking for: subproc attestation, SOC2 cert, and an all-in price for a small reserved pool + failover egress.

kai_se: Quick q — do they accept control-plane signaling from our global control plane (metadata only)? They said control-plane-only outside EU is ok as long as no payload leaves EU.

anita_legal: That should be OK but we need to capture it in the DPA and confirm what metadata is sent. I'll start subproc attestation template and request SOC2/ISO artefacts from them.

mike_infra: Tech note: we can tenant-pin to eu-central-1 and configure standby in eu-west-1 for HA. APAC fallback would be cross-border and requires explicit legal consent. BYO-KMS is supported via VPC peering or customer-hosted gateway; needs JWKS + cert exchange. Example config snippet for ops: 
```
tenant.pin: eu-central-1
fallback.order: [eu-west-1]  # no global fallback unless customer approves
kms.mode: external
kms.endpoint: https://kms.customer.example/v1
```

julia_se: Pricing ballpark: reserved 2-GPU pool ~ $18k/mo (commit) + worst-case egress bump for failover. I'll refine numbers once infra shares token/throughput profile.

sara_sales: They need an "all-in" monthly number for procurement. Can infra give a worst-case monthly delta if we lose eu-central and failover to eu-west (egress + transient routing)? Also need timeline to provide subproc list and SOC2.

mike_infra: Ballpark worst-case: +$2k-$4k/mo in egress for heavy failover scenarios (depends on token volume). I'll produce a calc in the ticket with assumptions (tokens/min, pct failover). ETA 48h.

ops_bot: Ticket INF-4921 created: "FinTrace POC - residency & BYO-KMS - certs + pricing". Assigned: mike_infra, anita_legal, julia_se. SLA: 3 business days for initial answers.

anita_legal: Action: I'll prepare subproc attestation + DPA note re: control-plane. Need vendor list and whether customer will allow our support logs to be stored outside EU (we should restrict).

kai_se: Action list for us: (1) confirm control-plane footprint to customer and get written approval; (2) infra to produce pinning config + worst-case cost calc; (3) legal to start attestation + request SOC2. @mike_infra @anita_legal @sara_sales any missing items?

sara_sales: That's it for now — I'll loop in FinTrace and ask them to sign the control-plane note and upload SOC2. Will update INF-4921 with their docs when they come in. :thumbsup:
